name: the-overview-pane-shows-no-address-bar
description: The address row and the extension strip float over every rail pane, so the Overview used to show the address of the space one swiped away from. Reads the bar's opacity and pointer-events on a space, on the Overview, and back on the space, and reads the header the pane draws instead.

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.urlrow'); if (!b) return 'no-bar'; const s = getComputedStyle(b); return 'opacity=' + s.opacity + ' clicks=' + (s.pointerEvents === 'none' ? 'no' : 'yes'); })()

actions.note: toggleOverview pages the rail onto the Overview

(() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.ovrailpane'); const rail = document.querySelector('.ovrailpane .ovrail'); if (!pane || !rail) return 'no-pane'; return String(Math.round(rail.getBoundingClientRect().top - pane.getBoundingClientRect().top)); })()
